blurb:
Set sail on Miami’s stunning waters aboard a 45-foot Sea Ray Yacht built for luxury and fun. This private yachting experience features a modern kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a stylish dining area, surround sound, and LED lighting for an unforgettable day or night. Swim in turquoise waters, lounge on the oversized floating mat, or sip your favorite drink while taking in Miami’s skyline and Biscayne Bay. Fully customizable, you’ll plan your itinerary with the captain—cruise past Star Island, anchor at Monument or Picnic Island, or spend time at Nixon or Bear Cut Sandbar. Perfect for celebrations or a relaxing escape.

Frequent Destinations:
Biscayne Bay
South Beach
Marine Stadium
Star Island
Picnic Island
Monument Island
Bear Cut Sandbar (Option available on 6 & 8 hour tour)
Nixon Sandbar (Option available on 6 & 8 hour tour)
